description: This source file defines classes, structs, and functions related to managing pairing alert dialogs and push notifications within a macOS application. It includes UI components, alert configuration, task handling, and approval/rejection logic for pairing requests.

classes.name: PairingAlertHostWindow
classes.description: A subclass of NSWindow that can become key and main window, used as the host window for pairing alerts.

classes.name: PairingAlertState
classes.description: A class to hold the current pairing alert, associated request ID, and alert host window, managed on the main actor.

methods.name: endActiveAlert
methods.description: Ends the currently active alert for a given state or explicit alert and request ID.

methods.name: requireAlertHostWindow
methods.description: Ensures there is a window to host the alert, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: configureDefaultPairingAlert
methods.description: Configures a given NSAlert with style, text, and buttons suitable for pairing approval.

methods.name: beginCenteredSheet
methods.description: Displays an alert as a sheet centered on the host window.

methods.name: runPairingPushTask
methods.description: Runs a task to refresh the gateway connection, load pending data, and handle push notifications.

methods.name: startPairingPushTask
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous task for handling pairing push notifications unless already running.

methods.name: beginPairingAlert
methods.description: Creates and presents a pairing alert sheet centered on a window.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert
methods.description: Displays a pairing alert with request ID and manages active alert and request ID state.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert with generic Request
methods.description: Displays a pairing alert for a specific request, handling user response asynchronously.

methods.name: clearActivePairingAlert
methods.description: Clears active alert and request ID, and orders out the alert host window.

methods.name: stopPairingPrompter
methods.description: Stops the pairing prompter, cancels tasks, clears queues, and closes windows.

methods.name: approveRequest
methods.description: Handles approval of a pairing request, executing a provided action and logging.

methods.name: rejectRequest
methods.description: Handles rejection of a pairing request, executing a provided action and logging.
